chunks: ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about henna, so he said:
“Indeed, the muhrim may touch it and treat his camel with it. It is not a perfume, and there is no harm in it.”

key_terms.بِطِيبٍ: as a perfume or scented substance
key_terms.ٱلْحِنَّاءِ: henna, the substance being asked about
key_terms.ٱلْمُحْرِمَ: a person in the state of ihram for hajj or ʿumrah

ai.seo_question: Can a muhrim use or touch henna during ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the use of henna by a muhrim during ihram. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that henna is not considered a perfume in this context, so there is no harm in touching it or using it medicinally.
